hero_eyebrow: Greater New Orleans · Free for everyone
hero_lead: We help New Orleans feel better, one step at a time. Come to a free fitness class. Or let us help you clear out clutter after a hard time. It's all free. Everyone is welcome.
programs_title: One group, two ways to help.
programs_sub: Hard times can knock you off track. We help you get back up. We build your body. We help clear your space. The two heal together.
p1_desc: Fun, coach-led workouts for every body. No experience needed. No fee, ever. Seniors and first-timers are always welcome.
p2_desc: Clutter can weigh on you. So can losing someone you love. We sit with you and help you let go, one step at a time. Your space — and your mind — can breathe again.
p2_point2: Support after the loss of a loved one
p2_point3: No motivation to declutter your space
mission_quote: We help Greater New Orleans get back on track — body and mind, together.
mission_p1: When life gets hard, it's tough to refocus. We're here to help. We help you put your health first. We help you clear your space, too.
mission_p2: You don't have to do it alone. We walk with you, one step at a time — until you feel like yourself again.
mission_p3: Grief, clutter, and poor health often come at the same time. We treat them as one journey. We help neighbors take back their homes and their health — for free.
step1: Go to the {{settings.venue}} schedule using the button below.
step2: Find Saturday's "Free Community Workout — Functional Fitness Class" at 11 AM. Tap Reserve.
step3: New here? Pick "Non-member." Then pick "Free Class — Drop-In Visit."
step4: Enter your email. Fill out the short form and sign the waivers.
step5: Make a password so next time is quick.
help_title: New to all this? We'll help.
help_text: Not sure how to sign up? No problem — send us a note through our quick form and we'll walk you through it.
